title: Theurian plugin compatibility declaration
description: Declares which Theurian Core versions and wire protocol a client plugin supports. Co-owned by Core and plugin maintainers; see docs/protocol/plugin-core-compatibility.md.

pluginVersion.description: Version of this plugin artifact. Independent of the Core version (ADR-0001).

minimum.description: Oldest Core version this plugin works against, inclusive.

maximumExclusive.description: First Core version this plugin does NOT support. Pre-1.0 this is the next MINOR, because a pre-1.0 MINOR bump may break the protocol; post-1.0 it is the next MAJOR.

protocolVersion.description: Wire protocol the plugin speaks. Must equal what Core reports, exactly. There is no negotiation and no fallback: an ambiguous protocol match is worse than a clear stop.
